nodes.name: brainstorm.md
nodes.summary: SDK starter skill defining a three-phase structured ideation workflow (diverge, cluster, converge) for agents to guide brainstorming sessions from open generation through organized prioritization.

nodes.name: catch-up.md
nodes.summary: SDK starter skill that instructs agents to produce a concise workspace restart summary, helping users quickly re-orient after returning to a project or conversation.

nodes.name: code-review.md
nodes.summary: SDK starter skill defining a structured code analysis workflow covering correctness, performance, security, and style, with a prescribed output structure for severity-ranked findings.

nodes.name: compare-docs.md
nodes.summary: SDK starter skill for side-by-side document comparison, guiding agents to identify agreements, conflicts, and gaps between two or more documents with a structured diff output.

nodes.name: daily-plan.md
nodes.summary: SDK starter skill that guides agents to generate a morning context-aware daily plan by scanning workspace tasks, deadlines, and recent activity, producing a prioritized schedule.

nodes.name: decision-matrix.md
nodes.summary: SDK starter skill for weighted option comparison, instructing agents to build a decision matrix scoring alternatives against criteria and producing a ranked recommendation.

nodes.name: draft-memo.md
nodes.summary: SDK starter skill for drafting structured memos or written communications from workspace context, with guidelines on tone, audience targeting, and document format.

nodes.name: explain-concept.md
nodes.summary: SDK starter skill for adjustable-depth concept explanation, guiding agents to tailor explanations from beginner to expert level with examples and analogies.

nodes.name: extract-actions.md
nodes.summary: SDK starter skill for pulling action items from unstructured text such as meeting notes or messages, assigning owners and deadlines in a structured output format.

nodes.name: meeting-prep.md
nodes.summary: SDK starter skill for context-aware meeting preparation, guiding agents to synthesize relevant workspace history and produce a briefing with agenda, talking points, and open questions.

nodes.name: plan-execute.md
nodes.summary: SDK starter skill defining a structured task decomposition and execution workflow, breaking complex goals into ordered steps with dependencies and tracking completion.

nodes.name: research-synthesis.md
nodes.summary: SDK starter skill for multi-source research investigation, guiding agents to gather, cross-reference, and synthesize findings from multiple sources into a coherent summary.

nodes.name: research-team.md
nodes.summary: SDK starter skill for multi-agent research coordination, describing how to spawn and orchestrate a team of sub-agents to investigate a topic in parallel and merge findings.

nodes.name: retrospective.md
nodes.summary: SDK starter skill for structured team or solo retrospectives, guiding agents to facilitate what-went-well, what-could-improve, and action-item extraction with a prescribed output format.

nodes.name: review-pair.md
nodes.summary: SDK starter skill implementing a writer-reviewer cycle where one agent drafts content and another critiques it, enabling iterative quality improvement through adversarial pairing.

nodes.name: risk-assessment.md
nodes.summary: SDK starter skill for project risk identification and ranking, guiding agents to enumerate risks by likelihood and impact and produce a mitigation-priority matrix.

nodes.name: status-update.md
nodes.summary: SDK starter skill for generating project progress reports, instructing agents to compile completed work, in-progress items, blockers, and next steps into a stakeholder-ready status update.

nodes.name: task-breakdown.md
nodes.summary: SDK starter skill for large task decomposition, guiding agents to break ambiguous high-level goals into concrete, independently executable subtasks with effort estimates.
